sheets.headline: Fire rated doors: EN 1634-1
sheets.overview: Our premium fire-rated steel doorsets are designed, manufactured, and tested in accordance with EN 1634-1. Tested as complete doorset assemblies, our products are classified for fire integrity, helping to prevent the passage of flames and hot gases during a fire event. Our doorsets provide dependable fire compartmentation for commercial, industrial, and public-sector applications.

sheets.headline: Therma-Line doors
sheets.overview: Therma-Line steel doorsets are designed to deliver reliable thermal efficiency with a U-value as low as 1.3 W/m²K. Engineered for commercial, industrial and residential environments, they combine durability with improved energy performance, making them suitable for both new-build and retrofit applications. They provide a secure solution where temperature control and long-term reliability are essential.

benefits: Designed to Meet Part L Requirements of the Building Regulations
notes: Table key: X = Feature Not Available; • = Available Feature.
Please note that hardware components can affect overall U-value results and impact the minimum manufacture sizes.
*Visions can be supplied using thermally rated glass; however, the U-value must still be considered an estimated performance at this time.
**Louvres are available but U-value performance will be affected – contact our team for more information.

Note: The performance of the Therma-Line product was determined by analysing samples of 1230mm wide by 2180mm high (singles) and 2000mm wide by 2180mm high (doubles). The resulting U-value can be attributed to doorsets at that size and with a ±25% size variation. Any size specifications outside of this scope can only be considered an estimated performance.

sheets.headline: Slimline: glazed security doors

Perfect for outdoor areas, it offers stainless steel options ideal for coastal and industrial zones. With customisable security features and a low U-value, it ensures both strength and elegance in any setting. Trust Slimline for uncompromising security and style. SBD licence product under the LPS 1175 SR2 and LPS 2081.
